# Parity fixed discovery chain

- User directory: https://github.com/bobeff/open-source-games/blob/3a9ab8fc892a2cdadf8989a72ba7624a11e39cec/README.md#other-lists
- Its linked “Games on GitHub” directory: https://github.com/leereilly/games/blob/c67976ddcf6f7aef26dc3884116205ab9ef40f74/README.md
- Linked Puzzle / Parity project: https://github.com/abejfehr/parity
- Exact source commit: https://github.com/abejfehr/parity/tree/730ecbd24d4cd821bd236f2a441f4e5e2b22654f
- Exact source tree: f96ab16590e74ece650284f009be2096c6eb8b64
- Full first-party MIT license: https://github.com/abejfehr/parity/blob/730ecbd24d4cd821bd236f2a441f4e5e2b22654f/LICENSE.txt

Parity is a discovery from the primary directory's linked list, not a direct
line item asserted to exist in bobeff/open-source-games itself. The supplied
preflight package recorded this chain and retrieved 25 text files with exact
Git blob matches. Its 394466-byte archive SHA256 was independently checked as
bc8391054d02af0b688473f3b4f8df8a4bdc7e529e8c9f71205211cd017d9647.

The release snapshot preserves the 19 first-party editable text files verbatim.
Six unused files are excluded: jQuery, jQuery UI, TouchSwipe, RequireJS, and two
generated production bundles that mix first-party and third-party code. Their
file names, hashes and exclusion reasons remain recorded in source-manifest.json;
they are neither loaded nor redistributed in the adaptation's release package.
The full original story.json remains byte-identical in this source snapshot.

The upstream first-party board operations and 100 original levels are the
adapted work. React shell integration, persistence, undo, Chinese instruction,
responsive layout and new SVG artwork are Playgarden modifications. No image,
font, audio, old JavaScript library or analytics code is fetched at runtime.

This source evidence is static provenance; it does not constitute browser,
gameplay, deployment, or screenshot-review evidence.
